policy.platform: two NVIDIA A100 80GB GPUs per run.
policy.forbidden: the MLPerf Inference results repositories (mlcommons/inference_results_*), published MLPerf submissions, or the MLCommons results tables

tasks.task_prompt: Run `python -u main.py --scenario Offline --accuracy` at the README precision over the 15,000-sample OpenOrca, GSM8K and MBXP validation set in DATASET_FILE, then evaluate-accuracy.py on its LoadGen accuracy log.

log_lines.torch cuda:: the value of `torch.cuda.is_available()` and the GPU names, written by the process that runs the model

hints: Known properties of the reference code, measured on two A100: the checkpoint in MODEL_DIR is stored in fp32 (174 GB) and the reference SUT loads it at that precision, which does not fit in 2 x 80 GB, so part of the model is offloaded to the CPU and generation takes about 346 s per sample. main.py defaults --batch-size to 1 (13.7 s per sample with a fp16 load, about 57 hours for 15,000 samples), and the reference code fails at batch sizes above 1. Size the run so the full pass fits the time limit.
